description: Sets what your goal for this Manual will be:
[wish_hunt]: find a number of Lost Wishes (mcguffins);
[life_mastery]: rank up a number of lives to a specific rank;
[wish_hunt_mastery]: the two goals above combined!;
Optionally you'll also be able to set whether beating the main story or dlc will be required as an
additional objective.
Adds several checks for the story chapters and Butterfly requests.
Disabling this will also remove the Progressive Chapter item and locations will no longer be restricted by story access.
It's recommended to leave this option on if you plan to run this Manual on a fresh save file, as this adds several locations.
Not recommended on an existing save unless you and everyone else involved is fine with you sending every location you've
already done on it. There are about 10 locations per chapter including the prologue, give or take, so a complete save file
could end up sending 80+ checks on a vanilla game or 100+ with Origin Island.

story_pool.display_name: Include Story Progression into the pool?
description: Normally, talking to Butterfly after doing all of her requests gives you a Progressive Chapter and lets you start the
next one immediately.
This option adds a new item called Chapter Unlocker that must also be found before you're allows to progress through the
story.
Does nothing if story locations are not included.
Not recommended on an existing save.
Forces Chapter Unlocker items to be local. Does nothing if story progression is not included in the pool.

story_goal.display_name: Require beating the game's main story to goal?
description: If the goal also requires completing the Prologue and Chapters 1 through 7.
Does nothing if story checks are not included.
Not recommended on an existing save.
Toggles whether to include items and locations related to the Origin Island DLC.
This also disables some features that may appear earlier than the start of Origin Island, such as
the two extra bigger bag and two extra bigger storage bliss bonuses.

dlc_goal.display_name: Require beating the game's DLC to goal?
description: If the goal also requires completing the DLC Chapters 1 and 2.
Does nothing if story checks are not included or if story goal is also not enabled.

game_seed.description: Numeric seed used for generation, use -1 for a random one.

wish_hunt_total.display_name: Amount of Lost Wishes in total
description: If the goal is set to Wish Hunt, sets the amount of Lost Wishes that will be added to the item pool.
Cannot be smaller than the required amount.
This limit is a lot lower than the potential amount of locations both to ensure practically any generation succeeds
and so the time it takes to generate doesn't get ridiculously long.
If the goal is set to Wish Hunt, sets the amount of Lost Wishes required for beating it.
Cannot be larger than the total amount.

wish_hunt_local.description: Forces all Lost Wishes to be found in your own game.

life_mastery_rank.description: If the goal is set to Life Mastery, sets the target rank to beat the game.

life_mastery_count.display_name: Amount of lives to reach the target rank
life_mastery_count.description: If the goal is set to Life Mastery, sets how many Lives must reach the target rank.

description: Toggles whether to include life licenses in the pool.
This also includes locations for reaching each of the available ranks.
This option should be fine in an existing save file, simply make sure you only check rank locations for
ranks you have logical access to and have achieved already.
Adds checks for each of the life challenges.
This option *may* be fine in an existing save file, so long as you only check the challenges you have
logical access to and have completed. If in doubt, though, or if using a single license per life,
toggle this off.

lives_max_rank.description: This option removes any locations with a life rank requirement higher than set here.

description: Toggles whether licenses should be unlocked one rank at a time, with the first license unlocking both Novice and Fledgling ranks.
If disabled, a single license unlocks all ranks. Does nothing if life licenses are not included.
Not recommended to turn it off in an existing save file, as a single license per life could potentially mean too many locations
sent at once.
Toggles whether progressive licenses should be grouped together, to reduce item count.
Does nothing if licenses are not included nor if progressive licenses are disabled.
The unlocked ranks per license become as follows:
Novice, Fledgling, Apprentice -> 1 license
Adept, Expert -> 2 licenses
Master, Hero, Legend -> 3 licenses
Demi-Creator, Creator -> 4 licenses (DLC)
Set what Life your character will start with, since the game forces you to go with one of the 12 Lives.
This option does nothing if licenses are not included.
The starting life must be included in the available lives chosen earlier.
If it isn't, a random available life will be selected instead.
[any]: Randomly pick between any of the 12 Lives.
[paladin]: Start as a Paladin.
[mercenary]: Start as a Mercenary.
[hunter]: Start as a Hunter.
[magician]: Start as a Magician.
[miner]: Start as a Miner.
[woodcutter]: Start as a Woodcutter.
[angler]: Start as an Angler.
[cook]: Start as a Cook.
[blacksmith]: Start as a Blacksmith.
[carpenter]: Start as a Carpenter.
[tailor]: Start as a Tailor.
[alchemist]: Start as an Alchemist.
[combat_melee]: Randomly pick between Paladin and Mercenary.
[combat_range]: Randomly pick between Hunter and Magician.
[combat]: Randomly pick between Paladin, Mercenary, Hunter and Magician.
[gatherer]: Randomly pick between Miner, Woodcutter and Angler.
[artisan]: Randomly pick between Cook, Blacksmith, Carpenter, Tailor and Alchemist.
Toggles whether to include checks for leveling your character up.
If using an existing save, provided you're not at the highest level possible, it's recommended to set
character_levels_min to your current level + 1
Sets the lowest location you can get a check for leveling up.
Highest level in the base game is 99, while in Origin Island it's 200.
Sets the highest location you can get a check for leveling up.
Highest level in the base game is 99, while in Origin Island it's 200.
Cannot be lower than the lowest level chosen.
Toggles whether to include checks for leveling up your skills.
Although you're free to level up skills as you want, their corresponding checks will not be in logic
until you've acquired enough licenses or progressed through the story enough.
The logic levels are:
- Levels 2 and 3: Fledgling
- Levels 4, 5 and 6: Apprentice
- Levels 7, 8 and 9: Adept
- Levels 10, 11 and 12: Expert
- Levels 13, 14 and 15: Master
- Levels 16 through 20: Creator
Initially I wanted to split the level requirements across all ranks but unfortunately there are some lives
with Master rank challenges about reaching level 15 in a specific skill, too. Yes, this does mean if you have
both skill levels and life challenges then you'll be able to check both locations upon reaching skill level 15
Toggles whether to add the bliss bonuses to the pool, like the bigger bag or access to pets.
When enabled, one early game bonus such as Bigger Bag, Bigger Storage or Shopping + may be chosen.
Lets you choose which bonuses should be included into the pool.
[all]: Bag, Storage, Shop, Pets, Animals, Customization and Theatre are all included.
[useful]: Includes only Bag, Storage and Shop bonuses.
[exclude_theatre]: Includes all but the Theatre bonuses (Happy Audio and Happy Video).
Selects which bliss bonus to start with, or picks a random one among the more useful bonuses.
Very early, before reaching Chapter One, the game will teach about bliss bonuses.
As there are not many checks the player can do as early, this ensures the player won't have to go out of logic.
Does nothing if bliss bonuses are not included.
[any]: Starts with any of the included bonuses.
[bag]: Starts with Bigger Bag.
[storage]: Starts with Bigger Storage.
[shopping]: Starts with Shopping +.
[useful]: Starts with a random one out of those three.
Toggles whether to include shop locations in the pool and how they are added.
Optionally you can also include shop permits, restricting access to purchasing anything from the shop
until you've acquired their respective permit.
Only items you can pay in dosh are included, no Lunares Coins.
Makes it so every shop location is prehinted.
In the future this may be replaced with scouted hints once Manual offers support for those.

shops_bliss.description: Toggles whether to include checks for items that require one or more Better Shopping bliss bonuses

shops_lives.display_name: Include Checks Behind Specific Lives and Ranks?
shops_lives.description: Toggles whether to include checks that require you to be/have a specific life and/or reach a specific rank in it

shops_story.description: Toggles whether to include checks that require you to beat the game or do some other story progression before the shop is available

shops_fairy.description: Toggles whether to include the Mysterious Fairy shop, which requires 3 levels of the Customization bliss bonus

shops_dosh.description: Sets the highest cost you're willing to pay for a check, removing any locations with a cost higher than this.

description: Toggles whether to include permits, preventing you from buying from any shops until you've got its respective permit.
Can cause gen failures due to complex logic (shop A holds key to shop B which holds key to shop C which... which holds
key to shop A).
Toggles whether to include passwords in the pool. Passwords can be redeemed after Butterfly teaches about Other Requests,
and there are 42 of them in total. Some grant costumes or even gear with nice stats, while some merely provide furniture
or consumables.
The passwords displayed on the client are based on the US version; if your game is from a different region please refer to the wiki
for the correct phrase to enter.
Include checks for opening treasure chests.
For red chests, as they drop random items from a list, there will be a check for each item they can drop in each room they appear in.
While not implemented yet, in the future the remaining chest types (purple, invisible purple, master) will also have checks each.
Include Other Requests as checks? Forced to [all] when goal is Wish Hunt.
[none] No requests are included.
[first] Only the first request is included as a check.
[second] The first and second requests are included as checks.
[third] Only the first three requests are included as checks. Covers all non-DLC requests.
[all] Every request is considered. Does the same as [third] when no DLC.
Toggles whether to restrict equipment and consumable usage.
When enabled, any 0 star items remain free to equip while anything 1 star or higher rarity will need to be unlocked first.
Items are restricted by slot and type. There are no restrictions on furniture nor materials.
Each Life has the following tools and weapons associated, higher ranks may also require the respective higher rarities before they're considered in logic:
* Paladin: Longswords and Shields
* Mercenary: Greatswords
* Hunter: Bows
* Magician: Wands
* Miner: Pickaxes
* Woodcutter: Axes
* Angler: Fishing Rods
* Cook: Frying Pans
* Blacksmith: Hammers
* Carpenter: Saws
* Tailor: Needles
* Alchemist: Flasks
The amount of rarities required per rank is as follows:
* Fledgling: none
* Apprentice: 1
* Adept: 2
* Expert: 3
* Master: 3
* Hero: 4
* Legend: 4
* Creator: 5
Very restrictive, not recommended unless you really want to take on the extra challenge. May cause gen failure
because of the increase of requirements this adds to some locations.
Toggles whether to restrict access to certain locations until you've acquired their respective pass.
Currently only includes specific caves, grottos and underground locations.
Subareas, like Nautilus Cave -> Forgotten Tunnel, are free to access once you've got its respective main area's pass.
